title: Mediterranean Beef Stir-Fry
blurb: Tender strips of beef cooked quickly with garlic, tomatoes and Mediterranean herbs for a simple weeknight meal.
steps: Slice the beef into thin strips against the grain and season with half the salt and pepper.
Heat half the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the beef in two batches for 2 minutes per batch until browned, then set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the remaining oil and cook the minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and oregano, then cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes break down into a sauce.
Return the beef to the pan with the vinegar and remaining salt and pepper, stir through for 2 minutes to heat, then serve.
